$schema.description: Offline editor schema reference, normally ./scenario.schema.json; ignored by simulation and digests.

schemaVersion.description: First-release JSON shape version; authors set exactly 1.

seed.description: Deterministic run seed; whole numbers 0–4294967295. Resolved only in the declared scope.

baseScenarioId.description: Bundled setup to inherit; 999 is Custom Game. Community runs always launch as 999 and stay unranked.

cash.description: Cash in dollars of the resolved starting year; finite numbers 0–1000000000000. Resolved only in the declared scope.

durationMonths.description: Playable months; whole numbers 6–1200. Resolved only in the declared scope.
